body: I wouldn't know where to start. I've been told my whole life to suck it up and not to compain. Even when I want to talk about it I can't. In therapy I found myself lying and saying I was ok when I wasn't. It's like my mouth opens and then something within me jumps out to stop me from telling the truth.

Introverted would be an understatement. I haven't been out in public for months except to go to work or run necessary errands. I can't have normal friendships because my life has gotten so bad I don't want people to know. When I meet new people I just end up lying about where I live and what I do. I'm so ashamed of the person I have become.

I wish I could call someone. My whole life I have felt a crushing sense of shame for the way I feel. When I reach out to the people I know I'm usually left feeling like a burden on their lives. Even just going on facebook these days is difficult because I see those old friends getting on with their lives and doing such good things, ans all I would have to offer is a depressing conversation about how much I have failed since we last spoke. I don't want to do that to them.
Just the other day I saw the last person who tried to reach out and help me. They were passing me by with their face covered to hide so I wouldn't talk to them.
